proposed_from.topic: Exact fixed-parameter optimization of Zhu et al.'s second-order spatial cluster-design risk. For a finite connected graph G, fixed K>=2, closed one-hop exposure neighborhoods, and rational symmetric PSD entrywise-nonnegative pilot covariance Sigma with positive trace, minimize the exact p=1/2 oracle residual criterion V(C;Sigma)=N^-1 sum_{i,i'} 2^{m_ii'(C)+1} Sigma_ii' 1{m_ii'>0} over nonempty G-connected K-partitions. Define the interaction graph F by adding G's edges and clique-completing every scope N[i] union N[i'] with nonzero Sigma_ii'. Prove an exact general MILP and, given a width-w nice tree decomposition of F, a sound-complete DP with bag labels, processed-edge connectivity partitions, and completed-label flags; give a conservative explicit FPT runtime, reconstruct the optimum, and output a rational table/backpointer certificate. Verify the C4 surrogate reversal with exact risks 33.04 versus 38.72, and prove the ordered-entry l1 pilot perturbation and true-design regret bounds. Position against Zhu et al. arXiv:2505.20130 and use Holtz et al.'s Airbnb pricing meta-experiment as consumer. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: A processed component of an unfinished label must meet the current bag; forgetting its sole remaining block closes the label, which then cannot restart. At joins, active connectivity partitions merge by transitive closure and an absent label completed in both children is rejected. Label-refining partitions are bounded by Bell(w+1), so K^(w+1) Bell(w+1) 2^K safely bounds states. Every nonzero-covariance scope is a clique of F, hence occurs in a bag and can be charged once at its highest bag. The exact MILP, C4 values, perturbation constants, dense-covariance loss of practical width, and generic connected-partition DP prior art were checked without finding a collision. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Complete the node-by-node soundness and completeness induction, especially the join compatibility rule for absent completed labels and the matching backpointer reconstruction certificate. EARLY KILL TEST: On G=a-c-b, K=2, Sigma=diag(1,0,1), use a width-one nice decomposition joining the leaf branches at bag {c}. With a,b labeled 1 and c labeled 2, reject the state where both children close absent label 1, but accept the separator-active analogue; stop if the DP table does otherwise.

seed_details.anchor: ZhuEtAl2025, Appendix B.1 and Appendix D
seed_details.opportunity: The exact residual term is explicit, but the implemented graph-cut objective omits the second-order term and globally optimizes only a surrogate.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace pairwise cut weights by one locally charged factor for each covariance-supported exposure scope, then enforce global connectedness with separator states.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Casel, Giannopoulou, and Niklanovits because their bounded-treewidth routine already handles connected partitions.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their state tracks prescribed sizes and processed connectivity on the objective graph; it neither localizes Zhu et al.'s covariance-scope factors on a larger interaction graph nor proves exact rational objective charging and certification.

seed_details.opportunity: The paper proves an upper bound for a first-order term but gives no condition under which the surrogate and exact criterion rank connected partitions identically.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Retain the discarded multi-label factors and compare their partition-wise difference with the cut score.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Zhu et al.'s Propositions 3 and 4 because their surrogate upper bound already controls the exact objective.
seed_details.rebuttal: An upper bound on one summand neither preserves rankings nor controls the omitted second-order term; the explicit \(C_4\) instance reverses the two orderings.

seed_details.opportunity: The displayed residual expansion substitutes independent fair cluster coins, while complete randomization of exactly \(r\) clusters changes every joint exposure probability.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace Bernoulli powers by hypergeometric probabilities indexed by the union and intersection of the two exposure-label sets.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from standard complete-randomization covariance algebra because only a binomial probability changes.
seed_details.rebuttal: Joint all-treated and all-control exposure events depend on two scope cardinalities and feasibility under \(r\), changing both the local potential and the optimization state.

seed_details.seed: Pilot covariance stability and selected-design regret
seed_details.opportunity: The iterative covariance update has no deterministic uniform perturbation or selected-design regret guarantee.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Uniformly envelope the design-dependent coefficient of each ordered covariance entry before applying the two-minimizer comparison.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from the triangle inequality and the standard plug-in argmin lemma.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection is substantially correct for a standalone paper; the bound is retained only as a robustness theorem supporting the exact optimizer.

seed_details.opportunity: The exact formula is specialized to \(p=1/2\), although treatment proportion can be a design choice under network propagation.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Keep the two asymmetric factors \(p^{-m}\) and \((1-p)^{-m}\) through the scope-cost derivation.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Zhu et al.'s pre-substitution formula because arbitrary \(p\) already appears there.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds for independent unequal coins; without jointly optimizing \(p\) or deriving a new certificate this is only a corollary.

seed_details.opportunity: Partition states give a Bell-number dependence, while rank-based connectivity compression may reduce the width exponent.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Define representativity after conditioning on bag labels and already charged nonlinear scope costs.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from the rank-based reduce operator because the states are ordinary connectivity partitions.
seed_details.rebuttal: The nonlinear label-scope costs and simultaneous connectivity of \(K\) labeled parts change the extension relation, so preservation under representative reduction is not automatic.

seed_details.opportunity: Treewidth of the geographic graph can be small even when covariance scopes clique-complete into a dense interaction graph.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Construct a family with \(\operatorname{tw}(G)=1\) whose scope objective encodes a hard dense partition problem.
seed_details.red_team: A hardness result parameterized only by \(\operatorname{tw}(G)\) says little because dense covariance visibly destroys locality.
seed_details.rebuttal: A sharp lower bound would certify that the interaction graph, rather than the geographic graph, is the necessary tractability parameter, but the reduction was not sufficiently mature for this core.

seed_details.opportunity: Buyer-mediated substitution and complementarity can produce signed covariance contributions outside entrywise-nonnegative spatial models.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Fold buyer consideration sets into seller scopes, then determine when signed local charges remain certifiably optimizable.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Pouget-Abadie et al.'s correlation-clustering formulation for bipartite experiments.
seed_details.rebuttal: That formulation optimizes an exposure-variance proxy and a heuristic, not the covariance-weighted doubly robust residual criterion with connected seller clusters.

seed_details.seed: Worst-case robust covariance design on connected partitions
seed_details.opportunity: Worst-case network designs use cut or semidefinite objectives, leaving exact connected partitioning under a structured covariance uncertainty set open.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Dualize the covariance uncertainty set before localizing its support function on a tree decomposition.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from recent covariance-matrix SDP designs because robustification already yields a convex objective.
seed_details.rebuttal: The 2026 covariance-design paper substantially occupies the robust-design direction, and the connected-partition restriction alone is not a sufficient delta.
